SEARCH
Package Model.SearchStrategies

Class SearchRadiusStrategy

java.lang.Object
Model.SearchStrategies.SearchRadiusStrategy
All Implemented Interfaces:
SearchStrategyInterface<Location>
public class SearchRadiusStrategy extends Object implements SearchStrategyInterface<Location>
A SearchStrategyInterface implementation that finds Business and Course entities within a given geographic radius from a specified Location.

  • Method Details

    • searchBusinesses

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<List<Business>> searchBusinesses(Location current)
      Searches for Business documents whose locations fall within the specified radius of the current location. First applies a bounding‐box filter for performance, then refines by true distance, and finally loads each business’s courses before returning the results.
      Specified by:
      searchBusinesses in interface SearchStrategyInterface<Location>
      Parameters:
      current - the center Location for the search
      Returns:
      a Task completing with a List of matching Business objects, each populated with its subcollection of courses.

    • searchCourses

      public com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<List<Course>> searchCourses(Location current)
      Searches for Course documents whose parent businesses fall within the specified radius of current. Uses a bounding‐box filter, then refines by true distance, and finally aggregates courses from each matching business.
      Specified by:
      searchCourses in interface SearchStrategyInterface<Location>
      Parameters:
      current - the center Location for the search
      Returns:
      a Task completing with a List of matching Course objects, each annotated with its parent businessId.
